4. Complete input and affine semantics

Implement up to four continuous rational parameters, 32 candidate policies, 64 complete declared worlds and 12 periods. These are development bounds, not demonstrated deployed capacity. Region count/encoding/byte/integer-growth/runtime limits must be declared before results; exceeding them produces honest partial coverage, not a smaller secretly substituted policy/world/domain profile.

D is a bounded rational polyhedral parameter domain with exact inequality/equality semantics and nonempty witness. Name parameters, units/currency/time/ownership/discount basis, allowed value sources and which revisions are parameter updates versus structural changes. Support declared lower-dimensional domains/faces and exact degenerate/equality cases rather than discarding them as zero volume. Invalid/empty/unbounded or unsupported domain semantics receive precise dispositions. Query values are exact canonical rationals; approximations/intervals need a supported robust-cell containment basis or fallback, never guessed midpoint membership.

The named policy family is immutable and qualified for the declared model/domain. Record the exact qualification basis and required owner evidence. Ordinary development family validation may establish conditional model-relative engineering; it does not manufacture protected field or S8 qualification. A policy may be a parameterized template only with independently checked parameter-to-original executable policy, lawful information/observations, constraints and payoff correspondence over D. A list of 32 policies is not the full M3 grammar. Global optimality needs a separate completeness/bound certificate and remains absent otherwise.

For each policyπ and complete worldw define exact affine whole-horizon utility f_(π,w)(θ)=a_(π,w)·θ+b_(π,w), and every required period/world financial/resource/liability constraint as an exact affine predicate. Robust value is V_π(θ)=min_(w in W)f_(π,w)(θ). Feasibility applies to all required worlds/periods, not just the utility-minimizing world. Preserve fixed-world correlation and original horizon aggregation; do not minimize each period independently and then sum.

Bind the original S4 utility/mandate and S3/S5 semantics. Changing discount rates, nonlinear underwriting, variable denominators, products of parameters, branch-dependent missing dynamics or learned coefficients do not automatically fit an affine profile. Reject unsupported transformations or provide their actual separately qualified representation; local linearization, sampled agreement or a nonlinear model label is not exact affine correspondence. Exact supplied model hypotheses can support MODEL_RELATIVE_EXACT geometry while their business adequacy stays unqualified.

The input must include permitted inquiry/action/wait/stop policies and their actual observation/rights/event requirements where supplied by the qualified family. Do not invent a no-action outcome. 5. Algorithm, certificates and boundary ownership

Build exact conditions for policy feasibility, within-policy worst-world switches, cross-policy ranking and ties. Incremental partition refinement is permitted and preferable where it avoids constructing an enormous unnecessary full arrangement. Every retained covered cell still needs whole-cell proof; build ordering cannot weaken acceptance.

Use a rational H-representation with explicit ≤, < and = facets or an equivalent exact cell representation. Declare a deterministic boundary assignment/query rule. Lower-dimensional equality faces and intersections are first-class. A fixed epsilon, rounded membership test or nearest cell is forbidden. Normalize equivalent hyperplanes safely without deleting orientation or equality semantics.
Suggested complete workflow:
1. Validate and freeze original domain, family, world/period model, quantities, tie rule, semantic dependencies, checker identity and budget. Record all material source/assumption gaps.

2. Maintain a complete domain decomposition frontier. Split a cell only on exact derived hyperplanes needed to settle feasibility, active worst worlds or competing policy values. Preserve all sides, including equality. A proof-carrying split tree with negative/zero/positive children is a suitable coverage representation.

3. For each cell, establish which policies are feasible throughout it, which are infeasible with original constraint witnesses and which remain unresolved. Split/refine unresolved sign changes or leave explicit uncovered leaves. A policy infeasible at the representative point may become feasible elsewhere.

4. For every relevant policy fix/check its active minimizing world or complete tied worst-world set on that cell. Certify f_(π,w*)≤f_(π,w) for every declared w throughout the cell. Identical duplicate payoffs may tie; world identity/correlation/support cannot be dropped merely because coefficients match.

5. Among feasible policies prove the selected policy maximizes robust value throughout the cell under the frozen owner tie rule. Retain exact optimal tied alternatives and their original executable refs. Comparing one assumed world, a sample or a centroid cannot prove this.

6. Independently check cell geometry/nonemptiness, original constraints, active worlds, all candidate comparisons/ties, policy projection and query ownership. Publish only accepted cells. Failed/unverified cells remain uncovered.

7. Independently check domain containment, partition/coverage and explicit gaps including boundary faces. Emit complete or partial atlas with exact predicates, witnesses, coverage basis, actual build/check costs and unresolved claims. Region explosion/timeout retains accepted cells and unexplored leaves; never fill gaps by interpolation.

The independent checker is specified before producer/oracle code and executes separately. It must reconstruct original coefficients/policies/constraints from owner input bytes; do not import producer partition/sign/ranking/geometry functions or accept producer-normalized assertions as the contract. Exact arithmetic and dimension/unit checks apply to every witness. Hashes, signatures, geometry library exits and independent processes are not substitutes for an independently specified predicate.

Whole-cell proof may use independently checked exact linear implication/Farkas or LP certificates, or an independently complete vertex enumeration in the cell’s affine hull with boundedness and complete H/V equivalence established. Checking producer-listed vertices is insufficient because an omitted vertex may refute the claim. A nonnegative combination of ≤ inequalities and signed equality multipliers must reproduce the original affine conclusion with correct constant/sign; every multiplier and primal/dual/infeasibility claim is checked exactly. Solver status alone is UNKNOWN.

Strict/half-open cells require explicit handling. A non-strict inequality valid on the closed relaxation supplies a sound whole-cell bound, but cannot prove a strict infeasibility or tie exclusion by itself. For strict-cell nonemptiness, an exact common-slack formulation with 0≤δ≤1 can tighten each strict facet by δ; a checked positive δ witness proves nonemptiness. Declaring such a cell empty needs an accepted upper bound showing no δ>0 or a checked contradiction, not an epsilon threshold. Equivalent exact logic is permitted. Equalities/lower-dimensional hulls require actual rank/affine-hull handling. Empty-cell declarations without valid evidence cannot remove coverage.

Coverage must prove D equals accepted cells plus explicitly represented uncovered regions under the declared partition convention. A complete checked split tree can establish this without solving a huge union-complement query. A dropped positive/equality child must have checked emptiness, or be retained as a gap. Measure-zero holes are holes; volumes, screenshots and sampled membership cannot prove completeness. If overlaps are allowed internally, exact shared-point decisions/ties and deterministic lookup agreement must be proved before query; contradictory overlapping recommendations fail.

For an infeasible cell check that every policy in the named family violates a supported original hard predicate throughout that cell. This is not global programme impossibility. For ties, preserve the set of feasible maximizing policies and owner selection rule at all boundaries/intersections, not only one winner. Domain-wide tie claims need cell-wide equality/strict comparison evidence, not equality at one point.

Each accepted cell contains original domain/family/model digest, exact predicate, nonempty/bounded/hull basis, feasible/infeasible policy dispositions, worst-world witnesses, winner/ties/comparison proofs and checker receipt. All 32 policies/64 worlds/12 periods are covered where required; missing members invalidate completeness. This is exact optimum over the named family, not expected field regret or causal validity.

10. R7 — PolicyAtlasCompiler
Single deliverable: DecisionAtlas.
Economic use: make repeated decisions and live revisions cheap by solving a qualified parameter region before queries arrive, while preserving a checked solution basis.
R7.1 Inputs and initial domain
Input a bounded parameter domain D, a finite qualified policy family, declared worlds, affine payoff/constraint functions and current semantic dependencies.

The proposed first development profile has up to four continuous rational parameters, 32 candidate policies, 64 worlds and 12 periods. These are development bounds. They do not imply that a nonlinear PE underwriting model already fits this representation.

The optimum is over the named policy family. Global optimality over M3's entire programme grammar requires a separate completeness/bound certificate. A map over 32 supplied policies cannot silently claim completeness over all possible programmes.
R7.2 Algorithm
1. Form exact boundary conditions for policy feasibility, changes of worst world, policy ranking and ties.
2. Partition D into the resulting polyhedral cells, subject to the declared build budget.
3. Associate each covered cell with a feasible winning policy or permitted no-action result.
4. Independently check each cell's feasibility and payoff comparisons over the entire cell.
5. Check boundary treatment and domain coverage. Emit explicit uncovered regions.
For a policy π, robust value is the minimum of its declared affine world payoffs. Cells must split where that minimizing world changes; comparing one assumed world for the entire domain is invalid.
Use explicit-MPC/polyhedral solution-map techniques as an algorithmic reference, not as a claim that ordinary MPC solves arbitrary financial contracts. [MPC]
R7.3 Output and ownership

DecisionAtlas contains D, policy-family digest, cell predicates, chosen-policy refs, comparison/feasibility witnesses, tie rules, coverage gaps, completeness basis and amortized build/check/rebuild costs.

An in-domain parameter update can query the atlas. A changed model structure, right, obligation interpretation or method invalidates the appropriate artifact through P7. Each selected policy still passes current S5 reservation/feasibility checks; an atlas cannot reserve capital permanently or disregard commitments created after its build.
Use native optimization and exact inequality checking. A browser animation or cached natural-language recommendation is not an atlas.
R7.4 Difference from X and completion gate

M5 compiles a native method that solves new instances. R7 precomputes a checked solution map over a parameter domain. It differs from ordinary memoization because a certified cell covers a set of inputs, not one identical request.

Functional gate: compare all covered cells with an independent bounded oracle. Test equality boundaries, narrow cells, infeasible cells, multiple worst worlds, uncovered points and stale obligations. An uncovered or invalidated query must invoke the admitted full-search fallback.

Comparative gate: compare against X's strongest native specialization at the same correctness and decision-loss basis. Include cold build, query, storage, checking, rebuild and invalidation costs. Report the exact reuse break-even count; a fast warmed query cannot conceal an uneconomic build.
R7.5 Failure behavior

Region explosion or a build timeout produces a partial atlas with explicit coverage. Do not interpolate into an uncovered region. A query with stale semantic dependencies or incompatible parameters returns to X's admitted search, not a guessed nearby policy.
